scope: Scenario B telemetry instrumentation used by the experiment overlays

items.notes: paymentservice and currencyservice use one server completion wrapper to compute duration/outcome and dispatch to conventional and OTel metric adapters. Payment shared application errors use the same event object.
CartService server RPC and Redis datastore completions supply the same measured duration/outcome to conventional and OTel adapters. Shared datastore errors are routed through both log adapters.

frontend HTTP/RPC client, checkoutservice RPC server/client, productcatalogservice server, and shippingservice server completion paths supply one duration/outcome to the shared adapters. Automatic OTel instrumentation is retained for context/spans; common metrics select the explicit tcc.otel shared measurements.

emailservice and recommendationservice gRPC interceptors own the shared server/client completion boundary and call the OTel observer with that exact duration/outcome. Decorator timers no longer independently emit common request metrics.

adservice ConventionalTelemetry owns the gRPC completion boundary. It sends the same duration/outcome to conventional metrics/spans when A is enabled and to the OTel metric adapter; the Java agent supplies native B context/spans.

readiness: STATIC_COMPLETE_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_PARITY_PENDING: ten application services have explicit adapter paths or justified N/A coverage; old RAW is not a source-parity gate. Fresh F4/F5 must validate the new paths before the integrated F1-F5 battery.
